name: Shopify and WooCommerce 1-Star App Churn Monitor

parameters.content:
## Shopify & WooCommerce 1-Star Churn Monitor (Zero-Key)

### How it works
1. **Manual / Daily Schedule Trigger** sets target Shopify App slug (`klaviyo-email-marketing`) and WooCommerce plugin slug (`woocommerce-payments`).
2. **Branch A (Shopify App Store):** Fetches public 1-star reviews (`?ratings[]=1`) and extracts review ID, date, churn pain categories (`billing`, `bugs`, `cancel_lockin`, `support`), and text excerpt.
3. **Branch B (WooCommerce / WordPress.org):** Fetches official `api.wordpress.org` plugin stats + 1-star RSS review feed (`?filter=1`).
4. **Normalize Churn Signals** merges both e-commerce feeds into a unified outreach/product-intel list.

### Setup & Attribution (MIT)
- **Zero API keys required.** Customize `shopifyAppSlug` or `wpPluginSlug` in **Configure Store Targets**.
- **Author:** [@truonggiang0111](https://github.com/truonggiang0111) (MIT License)
- **Hosted Skills / Cloud Batch ($5/mo free tier):** https://www.agensi.io/skills/wordpress-woocommerce-plugin-churn-spy | https://apify.com/ttyan0111/shopify-app-store-churn-spy
